headline: Pakistan Imports Record 15,000 Ton LPG Cargo to Avert Winter Deficits
summary: State-owned SSGC LPG Limited imported a record 15,000 metric ton liquefied petroleum gas shipment into Karachi. The cargo berthed under new guidelines intended to mitigate winter energy shortages.
why: Liquefied petroleum gas is a vital heating and cooking fuel across urban and rural Pakistan.
